prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1254; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while turning left at an intersection. The patient reported immediate pain in the right shoulder with restricted range of motion and difficulty lifting the arm overhead. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction, and positive impingement signs. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture, with findings consistent with a partial rotator cuff strain.

Over the course of 29 supervised therapy visits, treatment included a structured program of manual therapy, progressive range-of-motion exercises, scapular stabilization, and graded strengthening. Pain was managed with a combination of anti-inflammatory medication and scheduled ice application. Progress was gradual, with steady improvement in range of motion and strength through the middle phase of care.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full active range of motion, improved rotator cuff strength, and reported pain levels substantially reduced from initial presentation. Residual mild discomfort with repetitive overhead activity remains. The patient has been advised on a home exercise program and activity modification, with follow-up as needed should symptoms recur.
